extraction: Cell types and Gene names from Gene panel worksheet; verbatim values, header included
coordinate_basis: a00 script divides physical pos by 6.5/10 micrometer pixel size; fixedpos preserves physical units. CCF coordinates already transformed to zero-based 25um Allen indices in registration notebook.
gene_selection: All 106 named sequencing columns in supplied matrix. Published final_panel.csv has 104 unique markers excluding Hgf/Fezf2 but including five markers absent from supplementary table. Supplementary Table 1 lists 104 including three hybridization markers and Hgf/Fezf2; it excludes Rgs4, Marcksl1, Car10, Nrg1, Actb. Both are preserved for inspection. Do not label this run as exact 104-gene paper replication.
